name: Quantum Machines
short_summary: Developer of universal quantum control systems (hardware + software) enabling coherent and real-time orchestration of quantum processors across different technologies.

differentiators: Universal processor-agnostic quantum orchestration platform used by a majority of quantum hardware developers worldwide
Hybrid quantum-classical control enabling seamless real-time workflows
Scalable FPGA-based control hardware (OPX) paired with QUA programming language
approach.elevator_pitch: Quantum Machines creates integrated control and orchestration solutions that connect quantum processors with classical computing resources, enabling precise quantum system operations and real-time error management.

products: Quantum Orchestration Platform (QOP) with OPX control hardware

spun_out_of: Independent Israeli tech startup (founders with academic backgrounds at Weizmann Institute of Science and related physics research)

rounds.notes: Oversubscribed round raising $170M, bringing company funding to ~$280M. Existing investors also participated.

milestones.claim: Completed a $170M Series C funding round, expanding global market position and technology adoption.
Selected to establish the Israeli Quantum Computing Center at Tel Aviv University, serving industry and academia.

name: Classiq Technologies
short_summary: Developer of an enterprise-grade quantum software platform that automatically synthesizes high-level functional logic into optimized quantum circuits for deployment across cloud and hardware backends.

differentiators: Hardware-agnostic circuit generation and optimization
Enterprise-oriented quantum software stack with broad industry adoption
Partnerships with major cloud and quantum providers (AWS, Azure, NVIDIA)
approach.elevator_pitch: Classiq enables developers, scientists and enterprises to build, analyze, optimize and deploy quantum algorithms without needing deep hardware expertise, bridging gaps between theory and practical quantum application development.

products: Classiq quantum development platform (IDE & synthesis engine)
Integrated optimization tools for hybrid algorithms

rounds.notes: Largest quantum software funding round; part of extended Series C

milestones.claim: Completed a $110M Series C financing, the largest ever for a quantum software company.
Announced strategic up-round with AMD Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, IonQ, bringing cumulative funding to over $200M.

name: Qedma
short_summary: Developer of quantum error suppression, characterization, and mitigation software designed to enable reliable execution of quantum algorithms on today’s noisy quantum devices.

differentiators: Platform-agnostic error suppression and mitigation solutions for noisy quantum processors
High-precision characterization of multi-qubit systems with rapid speed-to-accuracy trade-offs
Integration with major quantum ecosystems (e.g., IBM’s Qiskit Functions)
approach.elevator_pitch: Qedma improves quantum computing performance by transforming algorithms designed for error-free processors into forms that can run accurately on current noisy quantum hardware, using error suppression, characterization, and mitigation techniques.

products: Characterization software for detailed, high-accuracy noise profiling

milestones.claim: Raised $26M in Series A funding to accelerate development of quantum error mitigation and characterization products.
Qedma’s software integrated into IBM’s Qiskit Functions ecosystem.

name: Quantum Source Labs
short_summary: Developer of scalable photonic quantum computing hardware using a hybrid photon-atom architecture to enable fault-tolerant, large-scale quantum systems.

differentiators: Photon-atom hybrid qubit architecture aimed at scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing
Deterministic entangling gates via strong photon-atom interactions
Architecture targeted to scale to millions of qubits with reduced infrastructure complexity
approach.elevator_pitch: Quantum Source Labs is building practical photonic quantum computers by coupling single atoms with photonic qubits, aiming for deterministic light-matter interactions that support fault-tolerant and scalable systems.

products: Photonic quantum computing systems (ORIGIN core engine initiative)

rounds.notes: Series A financing to advance photonic quantum computing hardware and scale technology.
Initial seed plus extended seed rounds to develop core photonic hardware and expand engineering team.

milestones.claim: Raised $50M in Series A funding to accelerate development of scalable photonic quantum computing systems.
Announced ORIGIN core engine at the Quantum World Congress, featuring board member and former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett.

name: QuamCore
short_summary: Deep-tech quantum computing startup developing a superconducting processor architecture designed to scale into the million-qubit regime within a single cryostat.

differentiators: Architecture-first superconducting processor design aimed at scaling beyond typical limits
Built-in error correction and high qubit density within a single cryogenic chamber
Reduces cabling and thermal bottlenecks via integrated control logic
approach.elevator_pitch: QuamCore pioneers architecture-first superconducting quantum computing, embedding ultra-low-power digital control logic inside the cryostat to overcome scaling limits and enable fault-tolerant systems with up to one million qubits.

products: Million-qubit superconducting quantum processor architecture (design & roadmap)

milestones.claim: Company emerged from stealth with $9M seed funding to build a scalable million-qubit platform.
Completed $26M Series A, raising total funding to ~$35M for architecture development and prototype commercialization.

name: Q-Factor
short_summary: Q-Factor is a Tel Aviv-based quantum hardware startup building a scalable neutral-atom quantum computer aimed at the million-qubit regime. It was founded in 2026 to commercialize decades of atomic-physics research from the Weizmann Institute of Science and the Technion, both of which remain shareholders.

approach.summary: Neutral-atom architecture designed to scale beyond thousands of qubits toward more than one million qubits, using atoms held and controlled entirely with light.
